column1: #! <NOUN> script hint atom function argument result
# A script that writes atoms, taken as a text file:   atom capitalOf   france  paris
# Only a plain line is cut: a function, an argument and a result, none of them quoted or
# computed. A loop, a quoted value and the comments stay as they are, in the script.
# It says nothing about kinds and speaks no language of its own, so its finds are tagged
